category_title: High-achieving bilingual Latino fifth-graders who disassociate from academic labels through mischievous behaviors
minimal_context: The student is working independently on a practice reading passage about elephants and its corresponding questions.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for independent practice. Please read the passage about the elephant and complete the corresponding questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Taps pencil rapidly on the desk) I'm already done with it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That was very fast. Did you read the entire passage?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: No, I just read paragraph one and two on the elephant. Then I saw the questions and then—um—it said paragraph six. So I just went to paragraph six.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to read every paragraph to prepare for the TAKS test. Please sit still and read it again.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts stomping his feet, then stands up and begins walking around the room) I'm not doing that. I don't want to be a schoolboy kissing up to the teacher just to get a lot of good scores.

task.content: Completing practice reading passages and corresponding questions on topics like elephants

context.materials: Practice reading passages, corresponding questions, pencils

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When expected to complete day-to-day banking-education activities and high-stakes test preparation
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Tapping his pencil, his feet start stomping, his mouth is going, and he's up walking around the room
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Desiring to disassociate from a 'schoolboy' label, which he defined as someone who 'would be kissing up to the teacher'

behavior_patterns.condition: In an effort to rush through the reading passages and corresponding questions
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Pretending to read practice passages, reading ahead, and skimming for pertinent information instead of reading fully
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Downplaying intelligence to avoid being authored as a schoolboy
related_quotes: No, I just read paragraph one and two on the elephant. Then I saw the questions and then—um—it said paragraph six. So I just went to paragraph six.
